app.name: ChatGPT
app.description: An AI-powered assistant for writing, analysis, coding, creative projects, and learning, built by OpenAI.

verdict.one_liner: ChatGPT may use your conversations and publicly available internet data to train AI models unless you opt out, but you can delete chats and use Temporary Chat.
verdict.summary: ChatGPT collects account information, device data, and all content you upload or type. By default, OpenAI may use your Content to train its models, and it also collects publicly available information from the internet for model development. You can opt out of having your Content used for training. OpenAI shares data with service providers, marketing partners, affiliates, and government authorities, and business account administrators may access your Content. You can delete conversations or your account, export data, and use Temporary Chat, which is not saved or used for training.
verdict.recommendation_reason: ChatGPT is useful, but it collects extensive data and may use your conversations for model training by default. OpenAI also trains models using publicly available internet data. If privacy matters, enable Temporary Chat, opt out of model training in Settings, and avoid sharing sensitive information.

red.title: Your conversations and public internet data may be used to train AI models
red.plain_english: By default, OpenAI may use the Content you provide — including prompts, files, images, and audio — to train and improve its AI models. OpenAI also collects publicly available information from the internet to develop its models. You can opt out of having your Content used for training in your account settings.

red.title: Contact Sync uploads your device address book
red.plain_english: If you choose to connect your device contacts, ChatGPT uploads information from your address book and checks which contacts also use the service.

red.title: OpenAI may share limited data with marketing partners
red.plain_english: OpenAI states it does not sell your Personal Data, but it may share limited data with select marketing partners to promote its products on third-party properties.

red.title: Business account administrators may access your Content
red.plain_english: If you use a work email or join a ChatGPT Enterprise or business account, your company's administrators may access and control your account, including your Content.

red.title: OpenAI monitors Content submitted on its platforms
red.plain_english: OpenAI states it monitors any Content submitted or exchanged on its platforms to detect fraud, illegal activity, or misuse.

green.title: You can opt out of model training
green.plain_english: OpenAI provides a setting that lets you choose whether your Content can be used to improve and train its models.

green.title: Temporary Chat is not saved or used for training
green.plain_english: If you enable Temporary Chat, those conversations will not appear in your history and will not be used to improve OpenAI's models.

green.title: You can delete chats or your account and export data
green.plain_english: You can delete specific or all conversations, Saved Memories, or your entire account. You can also export a copy of your ChatGPT history and data.

green.title: De-identified data is not re-identified
green.plain_english: OpenAI states it will maintain and use de-identified information in de-identified form and will not attempt to re-identify it, unless required by law.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT only accesses your microphone or camera when you actively choose to upload audio, images, or video.
categories.detail: The policy states that ChatGPT collects content you upload, including images, audio, and video. There is no mention of background camera or microphone access.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect Personal Data that you provide in the input to our Services (“Content”), including your prompts and other content you upload, such as files, images, audio and video.
concerns: Uploaded media may be stored and used for model training unless opted out

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT determines your general area from your IP address automatically. Some features allow you to provide more precise location from your device’s GPS.
categories.detail: OpenAI determines general location from IP address for security and product experience. Precise GPS location is optional.
categories.policy_excerpt: We determine the general area from which your device accesses our Services based on information like its IP address for security reasons and to make your product experience better... some of our Services allow you to choose to provide more precise location information from your device, such as location information from your device’s GPS.
concerns: IP-based location inference is automatic

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you enable Contact Sync, ChatGPT uploads information from your device address book to see which contacts also use the service.
categories.detail: Contact Sync is optional. The policy explicitly states it uploads information from your device address books and checks which contacts use the Services. It will notify you if contacts sign up later.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you choose to connect your device contacts, we upload information from your device address books and check which of your contacts also use our Services. If any of your contacts aren’t yet using our Services, we’ll update you if they sign up for our Services later.
concerns: Full address book uploaded including non-ChatGPT users
Contact data used to identify and notify about new signups

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT only accesses your files when you actively choose to upload them into a conversation.
categories.detail: File access is user-initiated for uploading files, images, audio, and video. No background file scanning is mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect Personal Data that you provide in the input to our Services, including your prompts and other content you upload, such as files, images, audio and video.
concerns: Uploaded files may be used to train models unless opted out

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: OpenAI shares your data with vendors, service providers, marketing partners, affiliates, and government authorities. Business account administrators may also access your Content.
categories.detail: Disclosures include vendors and service providers, marketing partners for promoting OpenAI on third-party properties, affiliates, business account administrators, government authorities for legal compliance, and other users when sharing content publicly. OpenAI states it does not 'sell' Personal Data.
categories.policy_excerpt: We disclose Personal Data to vendors, service providers, and marketing partners, including providers of hosting services, customer service vendors, cloud services, content delivery services, support and safety services, email communication software, web analytics services, payment and transaction processors, search and shopping providers, and information technology providers... We also share limited information with select marketing partners who are not service providers in order to promote our products and services on third-party properties... Affiliates... Business Account Administrators... Government Authorities or Other Third Parties... Other Users and Third Parties You Interact or Share Information With.
concerns: Multiple service and marketing partners receive data
Business account administrators can access Content
Public sharing of conversations exposes data to other users
Government disclosures for legal requests

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT requires your name, contact information, account credentials, date of birth, and payment information. OpenAI may use your data to estimate your age for age-appropriate experiences. If you use a work email, your employer may gain administrative access.
categories.detail: Account creation requires name, contact info, credentials, DOB, payment info, and transaction history. OpenAI explicitly states it uses data to 'estimate your age to give you an age-appropriate experience.' Business email domains may trigger employer notification and business account transfer. Age verification may require identity documentation through third-party vendors.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create an account with us, we will collect information associated with your account, including your name, contact information, account credentials, date of birth, payment information, and transaction history... to estimate your age to give you an age-appropriate experience... If you create an account using an email address belonging to your employer or another organization, we may share the fact that you have an account and certain account information, such as your email address, with your employer or organization... When you join a ChatGPT Enterprise or business account, the administrators of that account may access and control your OpenAI account, including being able to access your Content.
concerns: Age estimation performed for age-appropriate experiences
Corporate email domains may trigger business account transfer
Age verification may require identity documentation

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: OpenAI may share limited data with select marketing partners to promote its products on third-party properties, which may involve targeted advertising.
categories.detail: The policy mentions promoting products through direct marketing and on third-party properties, and sharing limited data with select marketing partners for this purpose. Users can opt out. OpenAI states it does not 'sell' Personal Data. Cookies and similar technologies are used.
categories.policy_excerpt: To promote our products and services to you through direct marketing and on third-party properties, and to assess the effectiveness of those efforts, subject to your choices and controls... We also share limited information with select marketing partners who are not service providers in order to promote our products and services on third-party properties and help us assess the effectiveness of those efforts... We don’t “sell” Personal Data. Depending upon your choices, we may share limited data with select marketing partners for purposes of promoting our products and services to you on third-party properties. This is known as “targeted advertising” or sharing for “cross-context behavioral advertising” under certain state privacy laws.
concerns: Targeted advertising with marketing partners
Cross-context behavioral advertising
Cookies used for tracking

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT is not meant for children under 13. Users under 18 must have permission from a parent or guardian. Teen accounts can optionally link to a parent or guardian for safety monitoring.
categories.detail: Services are not directed to children under 13. OpenAI does not knowingly collect data from under 13. Users under 18 need parent or guardian permission. Teen users and their parents or guardians can choose to link their accounts, allowing the parent or guardian to manage certain settings and receive alerts if OpenAI detects a serious safety concern. Targeted advertising is not used for users known to be under 18.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our Services are not directed to, or intended for, children under 13. We do not knowingly collect Personal Data from children under 13. Users under 18 must have permission from their parent or guardian to use our Services... Teen users and their parents or guardians can choose to link their accounts, allowing the parent or guardian to manage certain settings, and receive alerts if we detect a serious safety concern.
concerns: No robust age verification described
Teen account linking requires voluntary parent participation

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT logs your IP address, browser type, and how you interact with the app every time you use it. OpenAI also collects publicly available information from the internet to develop its models.
categories.detail: Log data includes IP address, browser type and settings, date and time, and interaction patterns. Usage data includes content viewed, features used, actions taken, feedback, people interacted with, timezone, country, access dates and times, user agent, device type, and computer connection. The policy also explicitly states: 'We also collect information from other sources, like information that is publicly available on the internet, to develop the models that power our Services.'
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information that your browser or device automatically sends when you use our Services. Log data includes your Internet Protocol address, browser type and settings, the date and time of your request, and how you interact with our Services... We also collect information from other sources, like information that is publicly available on the internet, to develop the models that power our Services.
concerns: Extensive interaction logging
IP address logged continuously
Publicly available internet data collected for model training

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: OpenAI collects your device name, operating system, device identifiers, and browser information to identify your device.
categories.detail: Device info includes device name, OS, device identifiers, and browser. Cookies and similar technologies are used for operation, preferences, authentication, and customer support.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about the device you use to access the Services, such as the name of the device, operating system, device identifiers, and browser you are using... We use cookies and similar technologies to operate and administer our Services, and improve your experience.
concerns: Device identifiers collected continuously
Cookies track preferences across sessions

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not clearly state whether ChatGPT collects health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No explicit mention of health or biometric data collection in the privacy policy. The U.S. state disclosures state: 'We don’t process sensitive data for the purpose of inferring characteristics about you.'
concerns: Not explicitly addressed in policy

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: ChatGPT collects payment information and transaction history only if you subscribe to a paid plan.
categories.detail: Payment data is only collected for optional paid subscriptions. Transaction history is retained for accounting, dispute resolution, and regulatory compliance.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create an account with us, we will collect information associated with your account, including your name, contact information, account credentials, date of birth, payment information, and transaction history.
concerns: Transaction data retained for accounting and regulatory compliance

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete conversations or your account, and export your data. OpenAI may keep some data for safety, legal, or fraud reasons.
categories.detail: Users can delete specific or all conversations, Saved Memories, or the entire account. Data removed within 30 days unless required for safety, legal, or financial reasons. Temporary Chats are automatically deleted within 30 days. Users can export data. Banned accounts and legal subpoenas may require retention.
categories.policy_excerpt: Once you choose to delete Personal Data, we will remove it from our systems within 30 days unless we need to retain it for longer as described below... If specific Content, or your account, is banned because of violations of our usage policies, we may retain that data for to protect our services from fraud, abuse, or other violations of our policies; If we are legally required to retain your data (for instance, we receive a lawful subpoena) then we may retain it for the duration of the relevant legal or regulatory obligation; When we are a party to a financial transaction... we may retain payment and transaction related information to meet our accounting, dispute resolution, and regulatory compliance purposes.
concerns: Banned accounts retain data for fraud/abuse prevention
Legal subpoenas may require extended retention
Payment records retained for accounting/compliance

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: OpenAI updates the privacy policy by publishing a new version on its website. It does not promise advance notice for privacy policy changes specifically.
categories.detail: The Privacy Policy states: 'We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will publish an updated version and effective date on this page, unless another type of notice is required by applicable law.' It does not explicitly promise proactive notification or a grace period for privacy policy changes. The 30-day advance notice referenced elsewhere applies to material adverse changes to the Terms of Use, not to the Privacy Policy.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will publish an updated version and effective date on this page, unless another type of notice is required by applicable law.
concerns: No explicit proactive notification for privacy policy changes
Users must check the page for updates
